label: last original token of a 9-token sequence (t=8, just before <DEL>)
explanation: Fires only in the original-input phase, almost entirely on the final original token of maximum-length (L=9) sequences (t=8; 90% of mass, 63% of such steps fire). A weaker secondary firing occurs at t=7 (the second-to-last token of L=9, or the last token of L=8), about 10% of mass. Never fires at t<6, on <DEL>, or in the copy phase. Magnitude is modulated by the identity of the input token: the strongest activations are on j and r (top examples are nearly all j/r at t=8), with h, a, 3 and p next. About 37% of L=9 final steps stay silent, and no simple token set or history condition (excluding vowels, digit count, first occurrence) separates them cleanly, so precision is incomplete.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: j, r, h, 3, a, p; least: q, u, t, w) and the first original token (most: w, k, t, m, u, 2; least: h, j, f, 3); timing cues that raise it most: L=9 & t=8, t=8, t=7.
